Definition: prolongation from the same base as G5567; to triturate, i.e. (by analogy) to rub out (kernels from husks with the fingers or hand):--rub.
BiblicalUsage: Psocho means to rub out, to rub kernels from the husks with the hands. It appears once, on the Sabbath: the disciples went through the corn fields, and plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the disciples' rubbed grain is the whole Sabbath argument in one handful: hunger is not work, and mercy is not breaking the law.
